# name language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](gmeow-nameLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/nameLanguage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The first-class [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) an appellation's surface form is in. [`Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) is ALWAYS a first-class [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) (registry-INDEPENDENT, self-minted IRI) — never a bare BCP-47 literal; codes (e.g. "ja", "zh") live on the [`Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) via [`gmeow:languageCode`](gmeow-languageCode.md), so a code-less conlang or AI-minted language names co-equally. FUNCTIONAL — exactly one language per appellation: co-equal multilingual names are modelled as SEPARATE co-equal [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) instances (one per language), never by multi-tagging a single name (that is what keeps naming anti-colonial and symmetric). Drives locale-relative, symmetric display selection — never a ranking of one name above another. The script the form is written in is [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md) (bridging to a first-class [`gmeow:WritingSystem`](../classes/gmeow-WritingSystem.md)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the single first-class [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) an appellation's surface form is in — driving locale-relative, symmetric display selection.

### Avoid when

- Avoid a bare BCP-47 literal (language is always a first-class [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) carrying its own code) and avoid multi-tagging one appellation with several languages — it is functional, so co-equal multilingual names are separate appellations.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](gmeow-nameLanguage.md) once per appellation (functional) to a [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) individual; carry the script with [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md), and never use the language to rank one name above another.

### Examples

- ex:yamadaName [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](gmeow-nameLanguage.md) ex:japanese.
